name: Daisy Duplicate – Duplicator for Posts, Pages, Custom Posts, and WooCommerce Products
author: DaisyPlugins

sections.description:
Daisy Duplicate is a lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to quickly duplicate posts, pages, WooCommerce products, and other content types. It preserves all metadata, taxonomies (categories and tags), and custom fields, making it perfect for content creators, developers, and site administrators.

Key Features:
– Duplicate posts, pages, and custom post types.
– Duplicate WooCommerce products with all product data.
– Preserves post meta, taxonomies, and custom fields.
– Simple “Duplicate” link added to the post/page/product list.
– Easy-to-use and lightweight.

License

Daisy Duplicate is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Credits

Developed by DaisyPlugins.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the daisy-duplicate folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Posts, Pages, or Products list in the WordPress admin.
  4. Click the “Duplicate” link to create a copy of any item.
sections.faq:
Can I duplicate WooCommerce products?

Yes! Daisy Duplicate supports WooCommerce products and preserves all product data, including attributes, variations, and custom fields.

Does this plugin work with Elementor templates?

Currently, Daisy Duplicate supports duplicating standard posts, pages, and WooCommerce products. Support for Elementor templates is planned for a future release.

Can I duplicate custom post types?

Yes, Daisy Duplicate works with most custom post types. However, compatibility may vary depending on how the custom post type is registered.
